sqlMap.select: SELECT CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_NAME, PARENT_ID FROM CATEGORIES ORDER BY CATEGORY_NAME
SELECT CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_NAME, PARENT_ID FROM CATEGORIES WHERE PARENT_ID IS NULL
SELECT C.CATEGORY_ID, C.CATEGORY_NAME, C.PARENT_ID, P.CATEGORY_NAME AS PARENT_NAME FROM CATEGORIES C LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES P ON C.PARENT_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID WHERE C.CATEGORY_ID = #categoryId#
SELECT CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_NAME, PARENT_ID FROM CATEGORIES WHERE PARENT_ID = #parentId#

SELECT CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_NAME, PARENT_ID FROM CATEGORIES WHERE CATEGORY_ID IN
#ids[]#
